note: Pamlico County publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The county's GIS viewer (AgDM Web AppBuilder, portal agdonline; layers checked in its webmap and the Pamlico_Static, Pamlico_ParcelService, Pamlico_Motorola_AGOL services) has no zoning layer. The county has no zoning ordinance or district map listed among its ordinances. Bayboro publishes its zoning map only as a JPEG; Minnesott Beach only as a PDF; Oriental's Growth Management Ordinance (with zoning districts) is PDF text with no GIS layer. No ArcGIS REST or WFS zoning districts layer was found for the county or its towns.
